bubbles.label: Quick links
bubbles.hint: Press Space to pick this link up, the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it, Escape to cancel. Right-click or Shift plus F10 opens more actions.
bubbles.limit: Pin limit reached. Unpin a link first.
bubbles.notPinnable: Only pages and apps can be pinned
bubbles.lifted: {{title}} picked up, position {{position}} of {{total}}. Use the arrow keys to move, Space to drop, Escape to cancel.
